klarity-prediction-market.title: Klarity
klarity-prediction-market.shortDescription: The Bloomberg Terminal for prediction markets.
klarity-prediction-market.fullDescription: Real-time analytics and data infrastructure for prediction markets. Think Bloomberg Terminal, but for Polymarket and Kalshi.

richard-ai-research.title: Richard
richard-ai-research.shortDescription: AI agents that do 8 hours of research in 30 minutes.
richard-ai-research.fullDescription: Most research tools wait for you to ask the right question. Richard doesn't. It crawls sources continuously, spots patterns across datasets, and surfaces insights with confidence scores — before you even know to look.
challenges: Built a proactive pipeline — agents surface insights without prompts, not just answer queries
Designed a feedback loop where output quality improves with each research cycle automatically
Every insight links back to its sources with confidence scoring, so nothing is a black box
outcomes: 16x faster — 8 hours of manual research compressed to 30 minutes
400+ actionable insights generated in the first 8 weeks
Full audit trail on every finding

mira-trading-bot.title: Mira
mira-trading-bot.shortDescription: $230K profit in 5 months. Tokens launched to $200M+ market cap.
mira-trading-bot.fullDescription: Speed wins in crypto. Mira watches social feeds and on-chain signals, then executes Solana trades in under 300ms — before the market reacts. Built the entire Go backend and real-time data pipeline with a 3-person team.
challenges: Built a Go pipeline that processes social signals and hits the chain in <300ms end-to-end
Parsed unstructured data from Twitter, Telegram, and Discord into tradeable signals in real-time
Maintained 99.5% uptime across 8,000+ monthly trades with just 3 engineers
outcomes: $230K net profit in 5 months of operation
Helped launch multiple tokens that reached $200M+ market cap
8,000+ fully automated trades per month

copile-trading-platform.title: Copile
copile-trading-platform.fullDescription: Crypto traders were juggling 5 different exchange UIs. Copile unified them into one interface with custom order types, real-time charts, and an API built for institutional workflows. Co-founded and led a team of 6.
challenges: Normalized order books and WebSocket feeds across 5 exchanges with different APIs and rate limits
Built custom order types (trailing stops, OCO, iceberg) that worked cross-exchange
Recruited, managed, and shipped with a team of 6 across backend, frontend, and design
outcomes: 70% user retention — most stayed after the first month
€1.2M monthly trading volume within a year
2,100 users with zero marketing budget

elevantiq-ecommerce-infrastructure.title: Elevantiq
elevantiq-ecommerce-infrastructure.shortDescription: Millions of orders. 45% faster processing. 7 repos → 1 monorepo.
elevantiq-ecommerce-infrastructure.fullDescription: Enterprise B2B e-commerce handling millions of orders per month. Inherited 7 tangled legacy repos and consolidated them into a single Nx monorepo while keeping production running. Built complex product configurators for clients with thousands of SKU variants.
challenges: Migrated 7 interdependent legacy repos into one Nx monorepo without any production downtime
Ran major framework upgrades (Vendure, Nest.js) on live systems processing millions of orders
Built product configurators that handle thousands of variant combinations per SKU
outcomes: Order processing 45% faster after the monorepo migration
Zero security incidents across the entire engagement
Clients processing millions of orders/month on the new stack

ibm-headless-commerce.title: IBM iX
ibm-headless-commerce.fullDescription: Built a headless Vue.js storefront on top of Magento for a retail client with 85,000 products. The marketing team needed to launch promotions without engineering tickets — so I built a self-serve promotion system.
challenges: Kept page loads fast despite 85,000 product SKUs and heavy dynamic filtering
Built a self-serve promotion editor so marketing could ship campaigns without dev tickets
Integrated Vue.js frontend with enterprise Magento backend via GraphQL
outcomes: Promotions launched 40% faster — marketing no longer blocked by engineering
Shipped to production within the 3-month internship
Frontend architecture adopted as the template for future projects

vendure-open-source.title: Vendure
vendure-open-source.shortDescription: Contributed to a 6.5k-star project. Used by IBM, Breitling, QVC.
vendure-open-source.fullDescription: Vendure is the leading open-source headless commerce framework (6.5k GitHub stars). Worked directly with the core maintainers on features and improvements. The platform is trusted by IBM, Breitling, Swile, and QVC.
challenges: Contributing to a mature 6.5k-star codebase with strict backwards compatibility requirements
Navigating enterprise-grade patterns (event sourcing, plugin architecture) across a large surface area
Ensuring zero breaking changes on a framework that runs in production for major brands
outcomes: Features shipped alongside the core maintainers
Deepened expertise in headless commerce architecture at scale
Ongoing contributions to the ecosystem

synapse-knowledge-system.title: Synapse
synapse-knowledge-system.shortDescription: Find the right expert in seconds. 2nd place @ TUM.AI x Anthropic Hackathon.
synapse-knowledge-system.fullDescription: Big companies lose time trying to find who knows what internally. Synapse fixes that — semantic search over employee profiles, project histories, and skill graphs. Built end-to-end in 36 hours at the TUM.AI x Anthropic Hackathon.
challenges: Designed the full backend, embedding pipeline, and search API from scratch in 36 hours
Built a ranking algorithm that weighs recency, expertise depth, and collaboration history
Used pgvector + OpenAI embeddings for sub-second semantic search across thousands of profiles
outcomes: 2nd place out of 30+ teams at the TUM.AI x Anthropic Hackathon
Working demo: any employee found in under 2 seconds
Production-grade architecture despite the 36-hour constraint

dreamcook-community.title: DreamCook
dreamcook-community.shortDescription: 5,000+ members. Real-time drop alerts. Profitable for 2 years.
dreamcook-community.fullDescription: Sneaker and streetwear resellers need to know the second a product drops — a few seconds late and it's sold out. DreamCook monitored retailers in real-time and pushed alerts faster than any competitor. Built it solo, grew it to 5,000+ paying members.
challenges: Built scrapers that monitored dozens of retailer sites and detected stock changes in real-time
Engineered a notification pipeline that delivered alerts in under 500ms via Discord and webhooks
Scaled from 0 to 5,000+ paying members with community-driven growth, no paid marketing
outcomes: Consistently faster alerts than competing services
Profitable from month 3, sustained for 2 full years
Ran the entire technical and business operation solo

acidnode-validator.title: Acid Node
acidnode-validator.shortDescription: Solana validator infrastructure. 99.9% uptime. AWS automation.
acidnode-validator.fullDescription: Running a Solana validator means your infrastructure needs to keep up with the chain — high throughput, low latency, zero excuses. Built automated AWS deployment and monitoring for a production mainnet validator.
challenges: Designed a fault-tolerant AWS architecture that handles Solana's throughput requirements
Built one-click deployment scripts with automated failover and health monitoring
Optimized validator performance to minimize skip rate and maximize block production
outcomes: 99.9% uptime on Solana mainnet
Fully automated deployment — new validator up in minutes
Zero unplanned downtime across the entire operation

neura-nft-sniping.title: Neura
neura-nft-sniping.shortDescription: Millisecond NFT sniping bot. Subscription product. Acquired.
neura-nft-sniping.fullDescription: When an NFT collection drops, the window to buy is measured in milliseconds. Neura watched for mints and executed purchases faster than manual buyers could click. Built it as a subscription product, grew it, and it was acquired.
challenges: Achieved sub-100ms execution from mint detection to on-chain transaction submission
Built robust transaction handling that adapts to network congestion and gas spikes
Kept the system stable during high-traffic mint events with thousands of concurrent users
outcomes: Acquired after 6 months of operation
Built recurring subscription revenue from day one
Consistently outperformed manual buyers and competing bots
